paper.title: One Adapter Pair per Model: A Universal Activation Interface for Language Models

local_claim_boundary: Exp6300 fits linear adapter pairs on Exp5852 embeddings only.
It tests held-fold alignment, reconstruction, neighborhoods, and model identity leakage.
It does not claim reusable probes, SAE features, activation tool transfer, NLA reuse, or energy-head value.

status.principle: The artifact must close with a terminal state.

paper_source_and_local_claim_boundary.principle: External paper claims stay separate from local evidence.

upstream_corpus_paths_hashes_and_termina.principle: The fit must bind to immutable Exp5852 evidence.

MODEL_SPECS.principle: The mandated model identities must not be substituted.

models_used.principle: The report must name every model that supplied embeddings.

model_embedding_dimensions.principle: Native dimensions explain why raw comparisons were unsafe.

no_live_model_load_receipt.principle: The adapter fit must not reload or query an LLM.

unlabeled_fit_contract.principle: Only matched row IDs and embeddings may train the adapters.

fold_manifest_path_and_hash.principle: The held folds must be frozen before fitting.

shared_dimension.principle: A fixed shared dimension makes all adapters comparable.

adapter_architecture_and_parameter_count.principle: Linear adapter size must stay explicit.

train_validation_and_holdout_row_counts.principle: Counts expose the data used by each fold.

reconstruction_metrics_by_model_and_fold.principle: Each decoder must preserve native embeddings within tolerance.

neighborhood_consistency_by_fold.principle: Shared neighborhoods must agree across models.

model_identity_accuracy_by_fold.principle: Model identity leakage must not replace semantic alignment.

chance_identity_accuracy.principle: The leakage gate needs a visible chance baseline.

raw_padded_and_random_projection_control.principle: Raw and random controls prevent shortcut promotion.

norm_length_and_token_count_controls.principle: Norm and token envelopes must not carry the result.

checkpoint_paths_and_hashes.principle: Saved adapter weights must be byte-addressable.

source_model_weight_mutation_count.principle: Source model weights must remain untouched.

shared_activation_bus_ready_score.principle: Readiness is a bare gate derived from held-fold metrics.

protected_files_unchanged.principle: Protected hashes prove source evidence was not rewritten.

preconditions_checked.principle: Hashes, dimensions, resources, seeds, and folds are checked first.

inference_substrate.principle: The substrate states that this is offline adapter fitting.

verifier_is_oracle.principle: This adapter audit is not an answer oracle.

field_provenance.principle: Every field must cite the evidence that produced it.

field_principles.principle: Every field must state why it is required.

test_commands.principle: The report lists the verification commands.

test_exit_codes.principle: Exit codes keep failed verification visible.

duration_s.principle: Measured wall time prevents padded runtime claims.

random_seeds.principle: Deterministic seeds make folds and controls reproducible.

reproducibility_checksum.principle: A normalized checksum detects artifact drift.

honest_verdict.principle: The verdict must start with a terminal prefix.
